species: Here, we exploited label-free quantitative tandem mass-spectrometry proteomics to create an in-depth proteomic survey of adult human brain regions.
tissue: A Multiregional Proteomic Survey of the Postnatal Human Brain
disease_state: A Multiregional Proteomic Survey of the Postnatal Human Brain
sample_source: Powdered frozen tissue was obtained from post-natal samples previously profiled by RNA-seq as part of the Brainspan Project (Fig 1A).
age: Single shot, label-free protein quantifications (LFQs) were obtained from the seven brain regions of 16 individuals spanning one year post conception to 42 years.
sex: Developmental samples spanned the period from early infancy (1 year post conception) to adulthood (42 years), and were derived from a near equal mix of male and female donors (Fig 1A; Table S1).
